ic_name: MIPI D-PHY / CSI-2 (TI SLLA414 application note)
notes: MIPI D-PHY / CSI-2 specifications do NOT define any OTP (One-Time-Programmable) / fuse content at the protocol or physical layer. CSI-2 packets are wire-level image data and carry no calibration constants. Vendor-specific data — e.g. per-lane skew trim, HS swing trim, LP threshold calibration, or PHY PLL trim — may be stored in an implementation's local OTP / fuse bank, but those values are entirely per-device-design (Synopsys / Cadence / Lattice / silicon-vendor PHY IP each define their own fuse map). Therefore this item is reported as NOT APPLICABLE at the MIPI specification level.
